title.en: What to include in a custom tin box RFQ
title.zh: 定制铁盒询盘需要提供哪些信息

excerpt.en: A practical checklist for tin shape, size, artwork, finish, packing, and export requirements.
excerpt.zh: 从盒型、尺寸、设计稿、表面效果、包装和出口要求出发整理询盘清单。

body.en:
![Custom tin box range](/assets/current-template/tin-category-range.jpg)

## Start with the application

Tell the factory what the tin will hold, how it will be displayed, and whether it needs an insert, food-contact interior, or special lid structure.

## Share structure and artwork details

Useful RFQ information includes shape, dimensions, lid style, printing colors, finish, embossing, and whether artwork is ready or still under development.

## Confirm packing and delivery needs

Include inner packing, master carton requirements, destination, inspection expectations, and target schedule so the project team can review feasibility quickly.
body.zh:
![定制铁盒系列](/assets/current-template/tin-category-range.jpg)

## 先说明应用场景

告诉工厂铁盒将用于什么产品、如何陈列，是否需要内托、食品接触内涂或特殊盖型结构。

## 提供结构和设计细节

询盘中建议包含盒型、尺寸、盖型、印刷色数、表面处理、压凸压凹以及设计稿是否已完成。

## 确认包装和交付需求

请写清内包装、外箱要求、目的地、验货预期和目标交期，方便项目团队快速评估可行性。

title.en: Food tin packaging: materials, linings, and retail use
title.zh: 食品铁盒包装的材料、内涂和零售应用

excerpt.en: How buyers can discuss food-contact expectations, product fit, and shelf presentation with a tin box factory.
excerpt.zh: 帮助买家与铁盒工厂沟通食品接触要求、产品适配和货架陈列效果。

body.en:
![Food tin packaging](/assets/current-template/food-tin-packaging.jpg)

Food tin projects usually start with product type, contact requirements, shelf life expectations, and display needs. Cookie, candy, chocolate, and seasonal gift tins may need different inner structures or protection.

A clear brief helps the factory review tinplate thickness, inner coating, lid fit, artwork placement, and carton packing before sampling.
body.zh:
![食品铁盒包装](/assets/current-template/food-tin-packaging.jpg)

食品铁盒项目通常从产品类型、接触要求、保质期预期和陈列需求开始。饼干、糖果、巧克力和节庆食品礼盒可能需要不同的内部结构或保护方式。

清晰的需求说明能帮助工厂在打样前评估马口铁厚度、内涂、盖合、画面位置和外箱包装。

title.en: Tin box printing and finishing options for brand packaging
title.zh: 品牌铁盒包装常见印刷和表面处理

excerpt.en: Compare direct printing, spot color, matte varnish, gloss varnish, embossing, and debossing for custom tins.
excerpt.zh: 了解定制铁盒中的直接印刷、专色、哑光、亮光、压凸和压凹等常见工艺。

body.en:
![Gift tin packaging](/assets/current-template/gift-tin-packaging.jpg)

Tin packaging can support clean brand color systems, detailed illustrations, decorative patterns, and tactile lid effects. Buyers should confirm artwork format, color references, finish preference, and whether embossing or debossing is needed.

For retail packaging, it is useful to review samples under real shelf lighting before approving mass production.
body.zh:
![礼品铁盒包装](/assets/current-template/gift-tin-packaging.jpg)

铁盒包装可以承载品牌色、插画、装饰纹样和有触感的盖面效果。买家应确认设计稿格式、颜色参考、表面处理偏好，以及是否需要压凸或压凹。

用于零售包装时，建议在接近真实货架的光线下确认样品效果后再进入批量生产。

title.en: Cosmetic and candle tin packaging guide
title.zh: 化妆品和蜡烛铁罐包装指南

excerpt.en: Key points for small tin containers used in balms, creams, candles, samples, and wellness gift sets.
excerpt.zh: 适用于香膏、膏霜、蜡烛、小样和护理礼盒的小型铁罐包装要点。

body.en:
![Cosmetic and candle tins](/assets/current-template/cosmetic-candle-tins.jpg)

Small tins need careful review of lid fit, surface finish, product compatibility, label or print placement, and packing protection. Cosmetic and candle brands often request a consistent color series across several sizes.

Share the fill product, desired capacity, lid style, color target, and outer packing plan when discussing a new project.
body.zh:
![化妆品和蜡烛铁罐](/assets/current-template/cosmetic-candle-tins.jpg)

小型铁罐需要重点评估盖合、表面效果、内容物适配、贴标或印刷位置以及运输保护。化妆品和蜡烛品牌常常需要多个容量保持统一色系。

沟通新项目时，请提供内容物、目标容量、盖型、颜色目标和外包装方案。

title.en: How the custom tin box sampling process works
title.zh: 定制铁盒打样流程如何推进

excerpt.en: A simple overview of structure review, artwork checking, sample confirmation, and production preparation.
excerpt.zh: 简要说明结构评审、设计稿检查、样品确认和生产准备的流程。

body.en:
![Factory QC](/assets/current-template/factory-qc.jpg)

A custom tin project usually moves through requirement review, drawing or mold discussion, artwork checking, sample making, sample feedback, and production preparation.

The smoother the files and structure brief are, the easier it is to align the sample with the final retail presentation.
body.zh:
![工厂质检](/assets/current-template/factory-qc.jpg)

定制铁盒项目通常会经过需求评审、图纸或模具沟通、设计稿检查、样品制作、样品反馈和生产准备。

文件和结构需求越清晰，样品就越容易接近最终零售陈列效果。

title.en: Export packing for custom tin boxes
title.zh: 定制铁盒出口包装要点

excerpt.en: How inner protection, master cartons, pallet planning, and inspection support safer international shipment.
excerpt.zh: 说明内包装、外箱、托盘方案和检验如何支持更稳定的国际运输。

body.en:
![Tin packaging range](/assets/current-template/hero-tin-packaging.jpg)

Tin packaging can be scratched or dented if export packing is not planned correctly. Buyers should discuss protective sleeves, inner carton layout, master carton strength, pallet requirements, and inspection points.

For retail programs, carton marks and packing lists should align with the buyer's receiving workflow.
body.zh:
![铁盒包装系列](/assets/current-template/hero-tin-packaging.jpg)

如果出口包装规划不当，铁盒可能出现划伤或凹陷。买家应沟通保护袋、内盒摆放、外箱强度、托盘要求和检验重点。

用于零售项目时，箱唛和装箱清单也应与买家的收货流程匹配。
